stem.text: A cell of internal resistance $0.5\,\Omega$ is connected to a fixed resistor of resistance $10\,\Omega$.
The resistance of the resistor is changed to $20\,\Omega$.

A.text: The current in the circuit will halve.

B.text: The e.m.f. of the cell will remain constant.

C.text: The power dissipated by the fixed resistor will decrease.

D.text: The terminal p.d. of the cell will increase.
